nodes.name: category
nodes.label: precious | industrial | energy | agri — the tracker's tabs.

nodes.name: currency_code
nodes.label: The currency landed prices in this market are expressed in.

nodes.name: currency_code
nodes.label: Always a major currency after conversion.

nodes.name: fixed_on
nodes.label: Date of the fix this day uses; earlier than rate_date when carried forward.

nodes.name: fx_share_of_move
nodes.label: Unsigned share of the rupee in the move, for ranking. Unsigned because the interesting case is a benchmark and a currency cancelling out, where the signed shares run past 1 and -1.

nodes.name: garman_klass_vol_30d
nodes.label: Garman–Klass (1980) OHLC range volatility over 30 sessions, annualised on 252.

nodes.name: is_duty_rate_confirmed
nodes.label: False for rows before the June 2026 verification (ADR-0001).

nodes.name: is_stale
nodes.label: The underlying benchmark is more than four days old.

nodes.name: is_stale
nodes.label: The latest benchmark is more than four days old. Always true for indicative levels until refreshed.

nodes.name: landed_change_20d_pct
nodes.label: The total the three contributions sum to, by construction.

nodes.name: lot_value_inr
nodes.label: Landed ₹ for one full lot (lot_size × lot_unit).

nodes.name: ma_crossover
nodes.label: The day the regime turned, so a desk can act on the event rather than the state.

nodes.name: ma_gap_50d_pct
nodes.label: Close against the 50-day mean, as a share of that mean.

nodes.name: ma_regime
nodes.label: 20-day mean above or below the 50-day. Null until both windows are full.

nodes.name: market_code
nodes.label: The market this sister is, from `var('market_code')` — one value per warehouse.

nodes.name: pct_of_52w_range
nodes.label: 0 at the 52-week low, 1 at the high. Bounded by construction: the range is widened to include the close, because the feed ships candles whose high sits below their close (see assert_candles_bracket_the_close).

nodes.name: price_basis
nodes.label: futures (live Yahoo feed) or indicative (group seed level).

nodes.name: price_basis
nodes.label: futures, or indicative when the underlying has no live feed (zinc).

nodes.name: quote_equivalent_inr
nodes.label: Landed ₹ for one MCX quote basis (quote_size × quote_unit).

nodes.name: realised_vol_20d
nodes.label: Annualised from 20 days of daily dispersion, on 252 trading days.

nodes.name: roll_yield_annualised
nodes.label: Near-into-next roll yield to a long, annualised; negative in contango.

nodes.name: stance
nodes.label: A shortlist to look at, never a recommendation. Cheap and rising is accumulate; cheap and still falling returns hold, because the range signal alone cannot tell a bottom from a knife.

nodes.name: tariff_id
nodes.label: The import_duties row applied on this date.

nodes.name: turnover_inr
nodes.label: Traded value in rupees (MCX states it in ₹ lakh; × 100,000). Additive within a day.

nodes.name: usd_fx_rate
nodes.label: Units of this market's currency per 1 USD on the price date; 1 when the market prices in USD.

nodes.name: volatility_regime
nodes.label: Against this commodity's own dispersion — 30% is calm for gas and extreme for rice.

nodes.name: z_score_60d
nodes.label: Standard deviations from the 60-day mean. Null until that window is full.

nodes.name: Agreement
nodes.label: A commitment between parties, with a lifecycle.

nodes.name: Commodity
nodes.label: A traded raw material with an international benchmark, quoted per a physical unit.

nodes.name: Contract
nodes.label: A negotiated agreement, usually with custom terms.

nodes.name: ContractSession
nodes.label: One exchange contract's trading day as the exchange settles it — open, high, low, close, the previous settlement, volume and open interest in lots, and turnover. Prices are per the contract's quote basis and never summed; volume and turnover are additive within a day.

nodes.name: Currency
nodes.label: An ISO 4217 currency. Qualifies every money amount.

nodes.name: Customer
nodes.label: A party that buys. May be a person or an organization.

nodes.name: Employee
nodes.label: Internal actor. Rarely modelled in marts; used for attribution.

nodes.name: Event
nodes.label: Something that happened at a point in time. Immutable.

nodes.name: ExchangeContract
nodes.label: A standardised exchange-traded derivative on one commodity — a futures contract, or one expiry's chain of options — identified by exchange, instrument, contract code and expiry.

nodes.name: FxRate
nodes.label: A daily exchange-rate fix — units of quote currency per one unit of base currency.

nodes.name: ImportTariff
nodes.label: Customs duty a jurisdiction levies on importing a commodity, valid over an interval.

nodes.name: Interaction
nodes.label: A touchpoint (email, call, session) with a party.

nodes.name: Location
nodes.label: A geography. Country, region, or address.

nodes.name: Market
nodes.label: A jurisdiction commodities are landed in — one sister project, one currency, one customs regime. The tenant of this family.

nodes.name: Organization
nodes.label: A legal entity. Customers may belong to one.

nodes.name: Party
nodes.label: Any actor that can enter into an agreement.

nodes.name: Payment
nodes.label: Movement of money settling an agreement.

nodes.name: PriceObservation
nodes.label: One benchmark price for one commodity at one point in time. Never summed.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.label: A sellable thing. Plans and SKUs are Products.

nodes.name: Refund
nodes.label: Negative movement of money against a prior payment.

nodes.name: Subscription
nodes.label: A recurring agreement with a plan, term and status.

nodes.name: Usage
nodes.label: Metered consumption attributable to an agreement.

nodes.name: ADR-0001
nodes.label: Duty rates are back-applied to history, and flagged

nodes.name: ADR-0003
nodes.label: Mean prices are ratio metrics, not `average` measures

nodes.name: ADR-0004
nodes.label: dlt Core lands the raw stage; dbt stages it

nodes.name: ADR-0005
nodes.label: commodity-india is one market of many

nodes.name: ADR-0006
nodes.label: MCX's own bhavcopy lands as one dlt pipeline per commodity

nodes.name: commodity_price_board
nodes.label: Live board of international benchmarks and India import landed prices across 33 commodities, modelled on MrChartist/commodity-price-tracker.

props.description: Mean daily settlement price, USD per quote unit. Group by commodity.
Mean customs duty per market unit, in this market's currency. Group by commodity.

nodes.name: avg_fx_share_of_move
nodes.label: Avg Rupee Share of the Move

props.description: Share of the 20-day landed move attributable to USD/INR rather than the benchmark or duty. High means the commodity call and the currency call have come apart, and timing the commodity will not recover the cost.

Mean import landed price in this market's currency per its market unit (benchmark × USD/local × (1 + duty)). Group by commodity; filter landed_price__is_duty_rate_confirmed to exclude history priced at a back-applied duty rate.
Mean roll-free daily return of the most-active contract. Group by contract_code.

Garman–Klass (1980) range estimator from open, high, low and close over 30 sessions, annualised on 252. About 7× as efficient as close-to-close; it understates risk that happens overnight. Group by contract_code.
High–low range estimator over 30 sessions, annualised on 252. Group by contract_code.

nodes.name: avg_mcx_premium_to_landed
nodes.label: Avg MCX Premium to Landed Parity

props.description: MCX settlement over the landed import-parity price of the same quote basis, minus one. Only codes the family prices. Group by contract_code.
20-session close-to-close dispersion annualised on 252 sessions. Group by contract_code.
Drift-robust OHLC range estimator over 30 sessions, annualised on 252. Group by contract_code.
What a long earns rolling the near month into the next, annualised — negative in contango, positive in backwardation. Group by contract_code.
Wilder RSI on the roll-free continuous series. Group by contract_code.
Mean 20-day rate of change. Group by commodity.
0 at the 52-week low, 1 at the high. Group by commodity — averaging this across commodities is a number about the basket, not about anything tradable.
20-day dispersion annualised on 252 trading days. Group by commodity.
Mean units of this market's currency per US dollar, as applied to landed prices; 1 for a USD market.
Days with a benchmark price. Group by commodity to spot feed gaps.
Month-over-month change in the mean benchmark price. Group by commodity.
Building block for avg_benchmark_price_usd. A sum of prices means nothing on its own.
Front-month futures volume from live feeds. Group by commodity.
Building block for avg_duty_local. A sum of per-unit duties means nothing on its own.
Signed rupee contribution summed over days. Group by commodity.
Days a landed price exists — never for commodities this market prohibits importing.
Building block for avg_landed_price_local. A sum of prices means nothing on its own.
Month-over-month change in the mean landed price; moves with both the benchmark and the currency.

props.expr: case when is_backwardation then 1 else 0 end

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_avg_premium_to_landed
nodes.label: Avg MCX Premium to Landed Parity — per Commodity

props.description: MCX settlement over benchmark × USD/INR × (1 + duty) for the same quote basis, minus one. Only commodities the family prices.
What a long earned rolling the flagship's near month into the next, annualised. Negative in contango.

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_backwardation_share
nodes.label: Share of Sessions in Backwardation — per Commodity

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_call_oi_notional_inr
nodes.label: Call Open Interest, Notional (component) — per Commodity

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_close_var_days
nodes.label: Sessions With a Close-to-Close Reading — per Commodity

props.description: Zero-mean realised variance of the flagship's daily log returns, × 252. Its square root is realised volatility over whatever window the query asks for.

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_contango_share
nodes.label: Share of Sessions in Contango — per Commodity

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_gk_var_days
nodes.label: Sessions With a Garman–Klass Reading — per Commodity

props.description: Garman–Klass (1980) OHLC variance per session, × 252. The most efficient of the four for a zero-drift market; blind to the overnight gap.

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_hit_rate
nodes.label: Hit Rate (share of up sessions) — per Commodity

props.description: Sessions the flagship settled higher, over sessions with a return.
Sum of the flagship's roll-free daily log returns — additive over time; exp(x) − 1 is the period return.

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_mini_turnover_share
nodes.label: Mini-Contract Share of Turnover — per Commodity

props.description: Turnover in the non-flagship codes (GOLDM, SILVERMIC, CRUDEOILM, ...) over all turnover — how retail the commodity's book is.
Notional of open futures positions across every code and expiry, at the period's last session. A stock — never summed over days.
What MCX reports as option `Value` — (strike + premium) × quantity. Premium is the smaller number traders pay; this is the exposure that changed hands.
Premium actually paid across every option chain — MCX's notional `Value` less strike × quantity.

nodes.name: mcx_commodity_parkinson_var_days
nodes.label: Sessions With a Parkinson Reading — per Commodity

nodes.name: agent-authority-is-least-privilege

props.intent: An agent reaches the filesystem through one path gate, and the paths it may never write are declared rather than remembered. Least privilege that lives in a prompt is a request; in a denylist it is a control.

nodes.name: agent-authority-is-revocable
nodes.label: A control that cannot be switched off mid-incident is a control you find out about afterwards. Revocation is checked before intent is written, and an unreadable

props.intent: A control that cannot be switched off mid-incident is a control you find out about afterwards. Revocation is checked before intent is written, and an unreadable revocation file fails closed.

nodes.name: agent-decisions-are-recorded
nodes.label: Every tool call an agent makes is written down before it happens and after it happens, and the gate's verdict is recorded for allows as well as denies. "No rule

props.intent: Every tool call an agent makes is written down before it happens and after it happens, and the gate's verdict is recorded for allows as well as denies. "No rule applied" and "a rule allowed it" are different facts, and only a record that carries both can answer what an agent was permitted to do.

nodes.name: agent-settings-schema-valid

props.intent: A settings file the client rejects loads none of the plugins it declares, and says so nowhere a session can see. The platform's own retrieval tools arrive as plugins, so a schema error silently removes kg_search and impact_analysis — and an agent with no graph reads files instead and never reports why.

nodes.name: anomaly-tests-do-not-gate-merge
nodes.label: An anomaly test judges data; a merge gate judges code. Wiring a statistical test into the gate blocks a correct change because yesterday's load was small, and t

props.intent: An anomaly test judges data; a merge gate judges code. Wiring a statistical test into the gate blocks a correct change because yesterday's load was small, and the cure is always to weaken the test — which is how the monitoring stops working.

nodes.name: builds-record-observability
nodes.label: A dbt build that leaves no queryable record cannot be triaged; failures get diagnosed from whichever log happened to survive. Every build must record its run an

props.intent: A dbt build that leaves no queryable record cannot be triaged; failures get diagnosed from whichever log happened to survive. Every build must record its run and test results into the warehouse with history — for every test framework at once — so "is this new, recurring, or flaky?" is a query, not an archaeology dig.

nodes.name: change-declares-blast-radius
nodes.label: A model or column change must report what it breaks before it lands, including the human who owns each affected exposure.

props.intent: A model or column change must report what it breaks before it lands, including the human who owns each affected exposure.

nodes.name: change-verified-against-baseline
nodes.label: A blast radius is a prediction made from lineage. Lineage cannot say whether the numbers actually moved, so a change to a mart must also be compared against a b

props.intent: A blast radius is a prediction made from lineage. Lineage cannot say whether the numbers actually moved, so a change to a mart must also be compared against a built baseline before it lands — otherwise "safe" means "nothing downstream references it", not "nothing downstream changed".

nodes.name: control-baseline-is-declared
nodes.label: A risk register that names controls nobody enforces is a document. Each entity declares in `air.yaml` which controls it commits to; those are derived from the r

props.intent: A risk register that names controls nobody enforces is a document. Each entity declares in `air.yaml` which controls it commits to; those are derived from the repository on every run and block the merge when they fail, while everything outside the baseline is reported and does not.

nodes.name: dev-server-binds-localhost-only
nodes.label: A development database served on a routable interface is an exfiltration endpoint with a bearer token. The endpoint is localhost by construction — the host is n

props.intent: A development database served on a routable interface is an exfiltration endpoint with a bearer token. The endpoint is localhost by construction — the host is not a parameter of the serving path, so a routable dev server cannot be configured into existence, only programmed, which is a review event rather than a config drift.

nodes.name: dev-serving-wire-is-read-only
nodes.label: Whatever arrives over the quack wire cannot mutate the warehouse. The server holds the database read-only, so the engine refuses writes at the catalog — not a p

props.intent: Whatever arrives over the quack wire cannot mutate the warehouse. The server holds the database read-only, so the engine refuses writes at the catalog — not a parser, not a callback, nothing that can be argued with — and the client refuses non-read statements before the network hop, using DuckDB's own parser rather than string prefixes. Writers exist; they borrow the file through the write window and never meet the wire.

nodes.name: entity-isolation-enforced
nodes.label: Business logic does not transfer between entities. A session that can read a sister project will carry an assumption across — a grain, a status enum, a revenue

props.intent: Business logic does not transfer between entities. A session that can read a sister project will carry an assumption across — a grain, a status enum, a revenue definition — and the bug that results is invisible, because the code it came from is correct in the project it came from.

nodes.name: entity-requires-identity
nodes.label: A class with no identity property cannot participate in a derived join, so every BI and MDL projection of it is a guess.

props.intent: A class with no identity property cannot participate in a derived join, so every BI and MDL projection of it is a guess.

nodes.name: evidence-chain-is-tamper-evident
nodes.label: A log an agent can edit is not evidence. Each record carries the hash of the one before it, and the head is anchored to a timestamp authority with no stake in w

props.intent: A log an agent can edit is not evidence. Each record carries the hash of the one before it, and the head is anchored to a timestamp authority with no stake in what it says — so editing the middle requires editing the end, and the end is countersigned.

nodes.name: high-impact-actions-need-a-human
nodes.label: Human oversight is a chain that shows the approval, not a document that asserts it. Approvals are append-only and bound to the action they approve, and an actor

props.intent: Human oversight is a chain that shows the approval, not a document that asserts it. Approvals are append-only and bound to the action they approve, and an actor approving their own action is a finding rather than an approval.

nodes.name: link-must-be-in-topology

props.intent: A foreign key pointing at a class the topology does not relate to is an undeclared join. Undeclared joins are how two teams compute different revenue from the same warehouse.

nodes.name: mart-declares-grain
nodes.label: Grain is the one fact a downstream consumer cannot infer and cannot survive guessing. An undeclared grain is how a join silently fans out.

props.intent: Grain is the one fact a downstream consumer cannot infer and cannot survive guessing. An undeclared grain is how a join silently fans out.

nodes.name: metric-owns-aggregation

props.intent: Aggregation policy — which statuses count, which timestamp, which filter — belongs to exactly one metric definition. A mart column named `revenue` is a second definition that will drift from the first.

nodes.name: model-routing-is-declared
nodes.label: Which model answers which step is a declared table, not whatever the caller passed. An unregistered step is recorded as such, and the recorded verdict matches w

props.intent: Which model answers which step is a declared table, not whatever the caller passed. An unregistered step is recorded as such, and the recorded verdict matches what actually happened rather than what policy would have preferred.

nodes.name: money-amount-bounded

props.intent: A monetary column with no lower bound accepts the negative row that a refund, a sign flip or a bad join produces, and it reaches a metric as a quietly smaller number. The currency rule makes the amount interpretable; this makes it credible.

nodes.name: money-requires-currency

props.intent: A monetary amount without its currency is not a number, it is a bug waiting for a second entity to be onboarded.

nodes.name: pii-not-in-consumption

props.intent: PII may land in raw and staging. It must not reach a mart or an exposure without a masking policy or an explicit, recorded waiver.

nodes.name: quack-token-never-leaves-the-machine

props.intent: The serving token is a bearer credential for the dev warehouse. It is generated fresh per server, lives only in a 0600 state file beside the database, is gitignored, is denied to agent edits by the gate, and is redacted from CLI output by default — a token echoed into a terminal outlives the server in scrollback and session transcripts.

nodes.name: quality-floor-derived-from-ontology

props.intent: Hand-written test coverage decays to whichever models someone remembered. props.intent: Business logic does not transfer between entities, so an assumption carried from one sister company into another is a bug by construction. A project session may not read or write another project, and may not write shared infra at all.

nodes.name: source-declares-freshness

props.intent: A mart is stale because its source was. Monitoring the mart names the wrong artefact to go fix, and monitoring nothing means the first report of a stopped pipeline comes from whoever opened the dashboard.

props.intent: A vendored upstream is evidence of what an external project actually does. Editing one turns it into a fork wearing a submodule's name, and every later diff against upstream reads as drift that nobody introduced.

nodes.name: warehouse-custody-is-recorded
